# WG7 · Doanh số của tôi · Tiền thủ thuật (bác sĩ)

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · state · Next.js: **planned (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `doctor-mai`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#work`
- Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
- `work()` for the doctor: own rows only, no entry form, no approve, void, close or export commands except the export button.
- Inventory note: Doctor projection of the work table: no entry form, no approve or void buttons, no period buttons. The rates and receipts tabs are hidden for a doctor (their placeholder panels are unreachable).
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `doctor-mai`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":".finance-workspace .metric, .finance-workspace .hero"} → {"click":"[data-finance-tab=\"work\"]"} → {"wait":"#export"}; it must show `#export`.

## Business rules
- Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".

## Differences from the app design
- (none recorded)

## Gotchas
- The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
- Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).
- The info box at the bottom of the frame is canvas-only documentation of the placeholder sentences of the two tabs a doctor cannot open ("Bác sĩ xem tỷ lệ trên các lượt của mình; chính sách chung thuộc kế toán.", "Tài khoản bác sĩ không xem thu tiền toàn phòng khám.").
